coverageNotes: 12 candidate files: 6 indoor (FTXP20M9/25M9/35M9/50M/60M/71M) + 6 outdoor (RXP20M/25M/35M/50M/60M/71M). Page 44 mixes generations: 20/25/35 indoor carry the '9' suffix (M9) while outdoor columns are 'M' (no 9); 50/60/71 indoor are plain 'M'. Monosplit pairings evidenced by efficiency-table column headers '20M9 + 20M' ... '71M + 71M'. Page blurb: 'Jusqu'à 3 unités intérieures peuvent être connectées à 1 unité extérieure multi' (multi-split eligibility, marketing; no invented pairing beyond published monosplit columns). Indoor airflow published m³/min, converted x60 -> m³/h (1 m³/min = 60 m³/h); original m³/min preserved in excerpts. Indoor electrical input published as min/nominal/max (complete-system) in ratings, NOT as a fact. Outdoor supply '1~/50/220-240' merged all outdoor columns; range preserved (no midpoint). Outdoor sound power published for cooling only (row 'Niveau de puissance sonore Rafraîchissement'); heating outdoor sound power NOT published -> unknown. Merged cells verified via page-44 PNG: indoor dims 286x770x225 (20-35M9) / 295x990x263 (50-71M); mass 8,5/9,00 (20/25/35) / 13,5 (50-71); outdoor dims 550x658x275 (20-35M) / 673x825x284 (50-60M) / 734x930x320 (71M); mass 26 (20-25) / 28 (35) / 36 (50-60) / 46 (71); R-32 charge 0,55 (20-25) / 0,70 (35) / 1,0 (50-60) / 1,35 (71); raccords 6,4-9,5 (20-35) / 6,4-12,7 (50-60) / 6,4-15,9 (71); longueur 20 (20-35) / 30 (50-71); dénivelé 12 (20-35) / 20 (50-71); operating range cool -10~48 heat -20~18 merged all outdoor; additional charge 0,02 kg/m >10m merged all outdoor.
